capabilities: Open the command palette by pressing Shift twice
Bind double presses of any key to any available command
Add multiple double-press shortcuts for different commands
Distinguish left and right Shift, Alt, and other modifier keys
Open third-party palette plugins via their commands
disambiguation: Not limited to Shift; any key, including left/right modifier variants, can be bound to a double press.
extras: Troubleshooting note: if a command does not appear in the command picker, disable and re-enable Doubleshift in the community plugin settings.
intentEvidence: By default, it opens the command palette, but you can change to whatever you want
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to trigger commands with a double key press like IntelliJ's double-Shift.

relations.evidence: if you have a plugin like the better command palette plugin installed you can choose the command

summary: Double-tap keybinding plugin that runs a chosen command (by default the command palette) when a key is pressed twice.
